top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs a quantitative prediction (flat bands at a magic twist angle, Bistritzer-MacDonald 2011) with an experimental discovery nature was not guaranteed to supply (correlated insulating and superconducting states, 2018), reproduced independently and extended to other moire platforms; the twist angle is a single control parameter that moves the system through a phase diagram. The three-name split into theory and experiment is the same across six members, and the citation claims no pairing mechanism. Maturity (about eight years), open superconducting mechanism and omission of Yuan Cao and earlier twisted-bilayer theory are real reservations, but they do not outweigh the breadth of new physics. P002 is a mature, cleanly credited two-name case that I rank second as a clear alternative, while P000 is last because two substantial, well-confirmed achievements are available.
